service: compose one admitted publication pulse through the exact assignment, newsroom, candidate, and delivery boundaries
ingress: one externally authored ActivityStreams Create<NewsroomIssueDemand> carrying an admitted Clockkeeper actor-capability pair
preconditions: operate-issue is advertised by Koios with this exact contract
the issue controller settles the exact pulse before any newsroom work begins
only an accepted controller settlement may nominate the assignment supplied to the newsroom circuit
postconditions: a controller refusal is returned byte-for-byte as the terminal response
a newsroom refusal or obstruction returns one typed PublicationCycleSettlement naming the earliest observed failure and required next demand
editorially accepted work produces one verified production-indexable cutover candidate, never a shadow artifact
candidate formation returns a StaticPublicationDeliveryDemand and does not claim live publication before Cloudflare delivery settles
every terminal result is appended to Koios's contract-event ledger and is suitable for a Clockkeeper delivery receipt
prohibitions: Clockkeeper does not source, write, edit, publish, deploy, retry, or repair
the composed operation does not impersonate Newscable, Corpus Management, LISS, editorial assessment, or Cloudflare delivery
a local candidate is never represented as live public delivery
no hidden provider fallback and no ambient customer or provider filesystem authority
